slides.stem: The population of a town grew by $30\%$ from 2020 to 2023. If the population in 2023 was $20{,}800$, what was the population in 2020?

slides.intro: Growth of $30\%$ means the new number is $1.3$ times the old one.
slides.trapWhy: $14{,}560$ subtracts $30\%$ of the new number, which undoes a change that never happened.

slides.title: Reverse a percent change by dividing
slides.body:
A $p\%$ increase makes the new value $(1 + p)$ times the old one. To go backwards, divide by $(1 + p)$.

Subtracting $p\%$ of the new value is never the inverse — percent changes are multiplications, and you undo a multiplication by dividing.
